name: Video Station
description: Browse and watch the videos on your NAS: a cinema library with poster shelves, Continue Watching, Movies/Series, search and My List; HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV on desktop and phones; resume, subtitles, TMDB metadata and a media-engine panel (VA-API/QuickSync/software). The video API stays in EthOS so the Android Video app keeps working.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.0.0: new cinema UI (full-bleed top nav, backdrop hero, poster shelves, detail pages, bottom tab bar on phones), server-side HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV with VA-API/QuickSync hardware decode and encode, a real media-engine panel with probe diagnostics, working quality/audio/subtitle pickers, server-side My List, responsive touch layout and lazy poster loading. Requires EthOS 2.12.0. 1.0.2: renamed to Videos as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: light theme for the shell, rows and empty states (the hero and player stay cinematic), and adding a folder uses the EthOS folder picker. 1.0.0: first release. The Video Station desktop app moves out of the core install; the video library API, thumbnails and streaming stay in EthOS, shared with the Android app.
